title: SHE CALLED ME BABY
lyrics_synced:
[00:10.86] She called me ba by, ba by, all night long.
[00:22.33] Used to hold and kiss me till the dawn.
[00:32.31] Then one day, I woke and she was gone.
[00:41.91] Now, there's no more ba by, ba by, all night long.
[00:52.36] She called me ba by, ba by, all night long.
[01:02.96] Kissed my tears a way when things went wrong.
[01:12.75] Oh, what I'd give if she'd just come back home,
[01:22.78] and call me ba by, ba by, all night long.
[01:33.20] She called me ba by, ba by, all night long.
[01:43.81] Held me up so high and made me strong.
[01:54.01] Now each night in dreams, just like a song,
[02:03.61] I still hear ba by, ba by, ba by, ba by,
[02:15.96] ba by, ba by, all night long.
